statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-53668 affects react-router-dom versions 6.30.2 through 6.30.4. No fix is available within the 6.x release line. The vulnerability has medium severity (CVSS 6.9) and only impacts applications with open redirects that permit attacker-crafted links to result in redirects to unexpected external locations or XSS vectors. Upgrading to react-router 7.18.0 would require a major version jump with significant breaking changes. Investigation is ongoing to determine if the vulnerable redirect code paths are reachable in unleash's usage of react-router-dom and whether alternative mitigations are feasible.
